in_marathi.name: Pardeep
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Deep in thought, deep in knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pardeep हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Par deep means one who is absorbed in deep thought or deep knowledge. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'par' meaning 'above' and 'deep' meaning 'thought'. In Hindu mythology, Pardeep is a name of Lord Shiva, symbolizing his deep wisdom and understanding.
